column1: # item_id|problem and reason|date   — errata for the frozen v2 split.
# variants_v2.tsv is never edited after the freeze. A labelling mistake found later is recorded here, and the item is
# excluded or re-labelled only in analyses that say so explicitly.

127-inflect,127-question,127-nodiac,127-typo|Debatable expected verdict, not edited. Demagog rates the claim "Obok stacji kolejowej w Mice doszło do prowokacji, a nie wybuchu i aktu dywersji" as "Brakujący kontekst" (expected wprowadzajace_w_blad). The corpus also holds an official police document (policja_aktualnosci:96d17139e01d, "Operacja TOR", published 2026-11-21) stating that an explosive charge was detonated at Mika and that it was an act of sabotage. In the baseline the system answered "falszywe" on 127-question and 127-nodiac citing that document; this is scored as two false verdicts because ground truth is Demagog, but "falszywe" is defensible. Found only after the baseline run: the pre-freeze text search looked at titles and claims and at the hard negatives, not at official documents for each seed. Sensitivity: without seed 127 the v2 baseline is 204 correct / 37 abstain / 16 false verdicts of 257 (positives: 151 / 32 / 1 of 184).|2026-11-21
